langs.title: Lokota
langs.subtitle: Lokota mingi ezali kotonga ndenge nazali kotala mokili. Lokota nyonso nazali koloba efungola ekuke na lolenge, makanisi mpe ndenge ya kokabola sango.

fr.name: Lifalansé
fr.description: Lifalansé ezali lokota na ngai ya libota — lokota nazali kolala, kokanisa mpe koloba na yango malamu. Nazali koloba yango na Suisse romande kowuta na moke. Ezali eloko ebele koleka kokabola sango: ekuke na litérési, diplomasi mpe lolenge ya kala. Na mosala, nakoma mokanda, nazali koteya reunion mpe kokoka kozwa malonga na lifalansé. Bopusi oyo epesaka ngai nguya kokabola makanisi na ndenge malamu.

en.name: Lingelesa
en.description: Lingelesa ekomaki ndeko na ngai na mokolo na mokolo, na mosala mpe na kotambola mokili. Nayebisi yango na koteya mingi: bato, kolia contenu (série, podcast, tutoriel tech), mpe na programmation wapi lingelesa ezali lokota ya mokili. Lelo nakoti mokanda technique, nakende na conférence mpe nasalaka na équipe ya mokili. Objectif na ngai: koloba malamu mpe koyeba maloba mingi.

ao.name: Lingala
ao.description: Lingala, lokota ya libota na ngai na Angola mpe Kongo, ezali na esika na identité na ngai. Koloba lingala malamu ezali kotonga ngai na libota, na story na ngai mpe na communauté wapi bavaleur — solidarité, humour, résilience — ezali. Nayebi moke Kikongo mpe. Lokota ya Afrika oyo ezali te heritage: ezali kotonga nguya na ngai kokanisa ndenge mosusu, kosala relation mpe kobongisa na contexte ya culture.

pt.name: Liputugalé
pt.description: Liputugalé ezali lokota nazali koyekola mbala na mbala, na libota na ngai ya Lusophone mpe maprojeti lokola Dandela Academy. Nazali koteya vocabulaire ya liboso, koyoka mpe kotanga, mpo nakoka kokabola mpe kosala na liputugalé na mosala.

dandela.name: Dandela Academy
dandela.description: Dandela Academy ezali école ya formation professionnelle certifiée na INEFOP (Angola), wapi innovation mpe digital ezali na kati ya boyekoli. Plateforme epesaka environnement moderne, flexible mpe interactif: cours ya structure 24h/24, formateurs qualifiés, mpe boyekoli guidé na IA mpo na personnaliser expérience. Mission: kopesa nguya na formation digitale mpe professionnelle mpo mwana-nyonso akoka kozwa makoki mpo asala malamu. Vision: projeti ya société mpo kopesa bana mpe professionnels nguya kotonga mokolo ya mboka na continent na bango. App ezali na PWA na lifalansé, liputugalé mpe lingelesa.

winno.name: Winno Bearz Club
winno.description: WinnoBearz Club ezali collection NFT générative na récit: sorcier Bearz BelzeBearz apesaki matoi ya WinnoBearz na mokili — okomonana na HolyBearz? NFT nyonso ezali unique, na combinaison 5 555 kowuta na 194 traits. Rareté ezali na calques (Raspberry, Picnic, Salmon, Honey, Beehive). Na programme: 5% ya retraits ya équipe na hasard mpo na moto moko, pleine propriété mpo na kobomba, kopesa to revendre, mpe na OpenSea mpe calendrier NFT. Esalemi na blockchain mpo na mint mpe communauté.

drilldev.name: Drill Dev
drilldev.description: Drill Dev ezali projeti na croisée ya développement mpe intelligence artificielle. Epesaka outils mpe contenu mpo na kosalisa développeurs mpe bato ya tech kosala progrès na flux ya travail moderne assistés na IA. Plateforme ezali na tutoriels, ressources pratiques mpe approche centrée na boyekoli continu, mpo makoki technique avancés akoka mpe na maprojeti ya soló.

playpad.name: PlayPad App
playpad.description: PlayPad ezali app mpo na bato ya padel na Suisse. Zwa bato na niveau na yo, sala match ouvert to compétitif, tala club partenaires mpe terrain na région na yo, mpe zwa match ouvert na clic moko. App ezali na marketplace mpo na kosomba to koteka matériel, classement na statistiques mpe suivi ya performances, mpe nguya kokweya. Créateurs ya match bakoka kozwa to koboya bato mpe kokamba réservation. Nyonso 100% gratuit mpo na bato. Club Manager epesaka club partenaires nguya kokamba réservation mpe recettes na plateforme moko.
